questions.stem: Which neuroglial cells reside within the Central Nervous System (CNS)? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: CNS neuroglia = Astrocytes, Oligodendrocytes, Microglia, Ependymal. Schwann = PNS.

questions.stem: Select all characteristics belonging to Red Muscle fibres:
questions.explanation: Red muscle is rich in myoglobin/mitochondria, slow-twitch, aerobic, fatigue-resistant.

questions.stem: Which anatomical structures contain Bipolar Neurones? (Select all that apply)
options: B) Olfactory epithelium of nasal cavity
E) Cochlea inner ear vestibular organ
answers: B) Olfactory epithelium of nasal cavity
E) Cochlea inner ear vestibular organ
questions.explanation: Bipolar neurones occur in retina, olfactory mucosa, cochlear ganglion.

questions.stem: Select all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes:
questions.explanation: Kupffer, Microglia, Dust cells, Langerhans are all specialized monocyte-derived histocytes.

questions.stem: Which features distinguish Cardiac Muscle from Skeletal Muscle? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle is involuntary, branched, has intercalated discs, never fatigues, single nucleus per cell.

questions.stem: Select all statements true regarding Bone architecture:
options: A) Matrix contains 65% inorganic calcium salts (Ossein)
C) Osteocytes reside in lacunae connected by canaliculi
answers: A) Matrix contains 65% inorganic calcium salts (Ossein)
C) Osteocytes reside in lacunae connected by canaliculi
questions.explanation: Bone has 65% inorganic ossein, periosteum sheath, canaliculi, vascular supply.

questions.stem: Which factors are required during the blood clotting cascade to form Fibrin? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Clotting requires Thromboplastin, Ca2+, Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen. Heparin is an anticoagulant.

questions.stem: Select all structural components found within a mammalian Haversian Canal: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Haversian canal transmits artery, vein, nerve, and lymph vessel through osteon.

questions.stem: Select all factors contributing to the resting membrane potential of a neurone: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Active Na+/K+ ATPase pump (3 Na+ out, 2 K+ in)
B) High permeability of resting membrane to K+
C) Low permeability of resting membrane to Na+
D) Presence of non-diffusible negative proteins inside cyton
answers: A) Active Na+/K+ ATPase pump (3 Na+ out, 2 K+ in)
B) High permeability of resting membrane to K+
C) Low permeability of resting membrane to Na+
D) Presence of non-diffusible negative proteins inside cyton
questions.explanation: Resting potential (-70mV) is maintained by Na+/K+ pump, K+ leakiness, and intracellular negative proteins.

questions.stem: Select all true statements regarding White Fat vs Brown Fat: (Select all that apply)
options: A) White fat is monolocular; Brown fat is multilocular
B) Brown fat produces heat via uncoupling protein-1 (thermogenin)
C) Brown fat is rich in cytochrome mitochondria giving brown color
D) White fat serves primary role in long-term energy storage
E) White fat generates heat in hibernating animals
answers: A) White fat is monolocular; Brown fat is multilocular
B) Brown fat produces heat via uncoupling protein-1 (thermogenin)
C) Brown fat is rich in cytochrome mitochondria giving brown color
D) White fat serves primary role in long-term energy storage
questions.explanation: Brown fat is multilocular with rich mitochondria/cytochromes for thermogenesis in newborns/hibernators; White fat is monolocular energy storage.
